body:
[A10] ONE list for review leftovers. Until now every merged pull request filed its reviewers' non-blocking suggestions as a new issue, which grew the open count without adding defects. From 2026-09-20 they are lines HERE: a suggestion gets its own issue only if it is a defect reachable in the product. Each group below names the closed issue that holds the detail. Pick lines off beside other work on the same file; tick them with the pull request that lands them.

## Build: IOB pack check (detail in #487)
- [ ] a FAIL row and the report written on a raise, not only the printed port
- [ ] an output whose DATA pin is parked while its T register is packed reads PASS naming the T register
- [ ] an owner for the four fabric LUTs that read `eth0_rx_dv`; the Arty pack status
- [ ] `subst` and `uplevel` rebuild spellings measured live; the named-line `split` allowance bound to its proc
- [ ] arms for a tristate output, a differential pair, a delay CSR pin; the stub's error code for `-of_objects`
- [ ] the two `pre_routing_commands` lines guarded; the red-recipe scope clause in BUILDING.md; two over-long lines

## Datapath: SRP status words (detail in #489, #490, #479)
- [ ] decide whether "listener observed" follows `LWSRP_STATUS[2]` (registered) or `[3]` (ready), document it, grade it in `pp_shadow` group T
- [ ] a group U arm at FailureCode 0; a named index constant for element 0; named constants in the GET_STREAM_INFO path
- [ ] the wrong address in the `ACMPL_STATE` comment; give `lstn_decl_state` a reader or drop the port
- [ ] remove the leftover sampling-rate table and its stale comment

## gPTP: latency correction (detail in #493)
- [ ] a saturating floor (or a stated assumption) for the ingress subtraction while the counter is below the constant
- [ ] the latency-key builder gate prints its evidence
- [ ] revisit the 3:1 split and the recorded bound when the instrument of #488 exists

## Saved state (detail in #494)
- [ ] the pinned-store census sees, or refuses, a store behind a brace-less `if`
- [ ] one graded read of the parent half of the pending bit in `pp_shadow`
- [ ] hosted sweep headroom for `nvm_cosim`; `-Werror-USERERROR` audited in the remaining `-Wno-fatal` suites

- [ ] the three controller-facing pages (REGISTER_MAP.md 0x924 [11], REGISTER_MAP_CLASSES.md, SAVED_STATE_FASTCONNECT.md 9.3) say the pending bit LATCHES until reset after a channel-map or name change while D3 is open (pull request 497 reviews)
- [ ] an executable parent-side check of the pend expression and the sticky class 6 / class 7 register: `pp_shadow` drives a SET_NAME and reads PP_STAT[11] (the co-simulation transcribes the glue; tying the product term off left both suites green)
- [ ] `scripts/naming.budget` header records that a pin bump may add a processor row, or `classify()` stops reading timing prose as a unit
- [ ] restore the two retired 0x005F limitation notes marked "retired at 0x0060" rather than editing a released CHANGELOG entry

## Descriptors and the builder (pull request 499 reviews)
- [ ] a change to a generator-owned-only descriptor field (the Identify reset_time is one) moves image bytes under an UNCHANGED entity_model_id: make generator-owned fields part of `model_shape()` or gate the image bytes against the id
- [ ] `docs/spec-refs.md` is named by the project instructions and does not exist: create the extract (the 1722.1 7.2.22 reset_time text is asserted in `avdecc/aem_descriptors.py`, not extracted)
- [ ] gate 28's config coverage follows the five tracked configs the way gate 37 does
- [ ] the processor's example descriptor JSON and its `tb/pp_top` literal carry the AVB_INTERFACE port number ungraded (protocol processor repository)

- [ ] PP (protocol processor) descriptor artifact: resolve the unused tracked `avdecc/aem_rom.json` drift measured during #464 (firmware_version, AVB_INTERFACE port_number and IDENTIFY reset_time). Establish whether to regenerate and gate it or remove/label the unused snapshot; preserve generated shipping bytes. [Exact baseline reproduction](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/d0d27ffe456962bba9d619278e572900d4ee2bde/review-evidence/464-r1/author/receipts/preexisting_aem_rom_json_drift.txt), [decoder](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/d0d27ffe456962bba9d619278e572900d4ee2bde/review-evidence/464-r1/author/receipts/decode_aem_rom_drift.py).

- [ ] PP (protocol processor) hand-built AUDIO_UNIT: consider deriving current-rate/count/length/fill-loop spellings from the compared AU_RATES_C array, or grading those extra spellings. Current values agree; this is optional drift prevention outside #478. [PR #512 / R222-1 S1](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/512#issuecomment-5776361061).
- [ ] PP (protocol processor) loader documentation: clarify that the eight-entry loader bound does not widen the packed-image restriction to 48/96/192 kHz. [PR #512 / R222-1 S2](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/512#issuecomment-5776361061). Keep #509 descriptor ownership decisions separate.

- [ ] PP (protocol processor) AEM fixture wording: optionally clarify that `_map_fixture()` also redeclares stream and cluster names, although those names do not bound mappings. [PR #513 / R235-1 S1](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/513#issuecomment-5777556715).
- [ ] PP (protocol processor) AEM self-test coverage: consider a positive 62-row AUDIO_MAP boundary and two-port INPUT/OUTPUT duplicate-rule controls. The existing single-port/count-refusal scope is unchanged by #464; B1/L1/L2 remain optional new coverage. [PR #513 / R235-1 S2](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/513#issuecomment-5777556715).
- [ ] PP (protocol processor) descriptor directory tests: consider cause-specific refusal oracles for contiguity and ascending-zero-based indices; current equivalence checks still refuse those layouts, masking isolated P01/P02 guard loss. [PR #513 / R235-1 S3](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/513#issuecomment-5777556715).

## CI and tooling (detail in #482, #469, #467)
- [ ] pin normalization aware of quotes and comments; a raw U+0085; an arm that runs git on a renamed path
- [ ] containment self-test under a global `core.fsmonitor`
- [ ] builder schema 1.2: three refusal arms without a gate arm; the capability-constant parser

## Docs (detail in #477)
- [ ] the "Unreleased" CHANGELOG entry retitled "Shipped with 0x0002_0059" and moved (decision recorded on #477)
- [ ] `hdl/common/csr/doc/milan_csr.md` generics table generated or gated; the boot diagram raster paired with its source by a gate





### PR #515 / R238 F3: optional container follow-up

- [ ] **R238 F3 SUGGESTION, Conformance and Robustness (pre-existing, outside #437 scope):** track HTML type-6/type-7 blocks opened at a list item's content column and held after the item ends. Published probes P02/P03 falsely authorize a heading rendered only as code/HTML (escape); F09 omits a rendered heading (withholding). Retain explicit ownership of the five documented setext/container-heading omissions from #437, with their withholding direction. Include first-paragraph P01/P04 only if #437's mechanism correction does not close them. This is optional follow-up, not an adopted implementation task or a severity change. [Original review and exact probes](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/515#issuecomment-5778167234); [immutable reproducer](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/f39bf814fc13b5741b57191777455401babec1bf/review-evidence/437-r1/reviews/R238-1).
title: [Residue] Review leftovers: one checklist instead of one issue per pull request
